name: How long does a typical interior floor replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical interior floor replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an interior floor replacement project depends on the size of the area, the type of flooring being installed, and the amount of preparation needed. For a single room, it might take 1-3 days. A multi-room project in a larger home could span 1-2 weeks, especially if old flooring needs to be removed and subfloors require extensive leveling or repair. We provide a detailed timeline during the planning phase of your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by size and flooring type, typically 1-3 days for a single room and 1-2 weeks for larger, multi-room installations.
